usage: music-tagger tag [-h] --release-id RELEASE_ID [--dry-run] [--log LOG |
                        --no-log] [--ignore-locks] [--approve-overwrites]
                        [--isrc {keep,musicbrainz}]
                        [--isrc-code [DISC-]TRACK=CODE]
                        path

Fetch release, compute diff, and apply tags.

positional arguments:
  path                  Album directory.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --release-id RELEASE_ID
                        MusicBrainz release UUID.
  --dry-run             Show diff without writing.
  --log LOG             Append changes to this log file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log              Do not write the change log.
  --ignore-locks        Overwrite locked fields too. The locks themselves stay
                        in place.
  --approve-overwrites  Write changes that replace a non-empty title, artist,
                        album, albumartist, or date.
  --isrc {keep,musicbrainz}
                        Resolve ISRC conflicts: keep (and lock) the file
                        codes, or take MusicBrainz's code where it lists
                        exactly one.
  --isrc-code [DISC-]TRACK=CODE
                        Resolve one track's ISRC conflict to CODE. Overrides
                        --isrc for that track.
